base_row_contract: Scenario, packet, supervision and pair rows retain rondo-publication-critic-training-data-schema-v1; v7 rows remain byte-identical and Plan 064 rows use the same strict packet and supervision semantics.

requirements: Every base scenario, packet, supervision and pair is present and canonically identical.
Every base candidate retains its frozen split.
New IDs never collide with base IDs.
The complete logical release is checked as one set.

review_disposition_contract.inherited_v7: Allowed only for a canonically identical candidate in the immutable v7 base.
review_disposition_contract.direct_accept: Requires a terminal independent candidate review bound to the current candidate content and label.
review_disposition_contract.plan064_policy: Plan 064 v8 uses direct_accept for every new candidate. Risk-stratified sampling is an additional audit and never an admission mechanism.

pair_review_contract.inherited_v7: Allowed only for a canonically identical v7 pair.
pair_review_contract.direct_accept: Required for every new Boundary or Within-PASS pair.

semantic_inputs: complete supervision rows including labels and proposed splits
quality-audit evidence bound to the complete candidate, label, defect, pair content and final split assignment
prefreeze_identity_contract.approval_invalidation: Any semantic input change invalidates freeze approval.
prefreeze_identity_contract.runner_replay: A runner-only repair may replay the mechanical chain only when the semantic universe identity is unchanged.

phase_contract.prefreeze: Ignored checkpoint and reports only; no formal training directory, manifest, data card or GO claim.
phase_contract.freeze: Requires explicit approval for the exact prefreeze identity and a new empty output directory, then reruns the complete final chain.
